SQL_DOC.P_SQL: BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT QUOTATION_NO FROM KEP_RE WHERE QUOTATION_NO = RTRIM($QUOTATION_NO$) AND QUOTATION_SEQ = RTRIM($QUOTATION_SEQ$) ) BEGIN INSERT INTO KEP_RE ( PLANT , QUOTATION_NO , QUOTATION_SEQ , REVISION_NO , BUYER_ITEM_NO , UNIT_PRICE01 , REMARK , IF_FLAG , IF_DATE , IF_TIME ) VALUES ( $PLANT$ , $QUOTATION_NO$ , $QUOTATION_SEQ$ , $REVISION_NO$ , $BUYER_ITEM_NO$ , $UNIT_PRICE01$ , $REMARK$ , 'N' , $IF_DATE$ , $IF_TIME$ ) END ELSE BEGIN UPDATE KEP_RE SET UNIT_PRICE01 = $UNIT_PRICE01$ , REMARK = $REMARK$ , IF_FLAG = 'N' , IF_DATE = $IF_DATE$ , IF_TIME = $IF_TIME$ WHERE QUOTATION_NO = RTRIM($QUOTATION_NO$) AND QUOTATION_SEQ = RTRIM($QUOTATION_SEQ$) END END
